description: F04 TextAttribute, rendition and cursor-presentation method-level equivalence evidence, including portable renderer color resolution.

entries.notes: Rust reproduces Microsoft's FOREGROUND_BLUE | BACKGROUND_RED construction, IsLegacy observable, and exact legacy round-trip through the production TextAttribute owner.
Rust reproduces the five Microsoft COMMON_LVB meta-bit vectors, preserves each bit in TextAttribute character attributes, and round-trips the complete legacy word.
Rust iterates the Microsoft legacy attribute domain, skips the same reserved and DBCS bits, and requires exact round-trip through the production TextAttribute owner.

Rust uses an explicit LegacyColorDefaults value instead of Microsoft's mutable process-global defaults, but reproduces all three source observables: default foreground, default background, and both defaults map bidirectionally to the configured legacy indices.

The production renderer now composes TextAttribute/TextColor lookup with faint, reverse-video and invisible policy. The direct Rust witness reproduces Microsoft's RGB getter invariants and all six calculated foreground/background transitions.

The portable renderer resolver reproduces Microsoft's configured default foreground/background aliases, reverse-video swap, explicit foreground mutation, invert, and restored-default foreground with explicit background.

Rust reproduces the complete Microsoft IntenseIsBright matrix: defaults remain unchanged, dark indexed foreground brightens only while the mode is enabled and intensity is set, background is unaffected, intensity-off disables brightening, and an already-bright foreground remains bright with the mode either enabled or disabled.
